race.title: Oddschecker Mares' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: An open-looking mares' handicap in which it could pay to side with LIMERICK LASS , who acquitted herself well in a handful of starts last season and Anthony Honeyball's 6-y-o should have more to offer now handicapping. Stablemate Queen's Theatre has a similar profile to the selection, so she could be the one to provide most resistance, with returning Dawn Run winner White Noise rounding off the shortlist. LIMERICK LASS (IRE) QUEEN'S THEATRE WHITE NOISE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: White Noise (13/8), Queen's Theatre (4/1), Miss Goldfire (7/1), Just A Glance (8/1), Porter In The Park (8/1), Limerick Lass (8/1), Rialannah (12/1), Karoline Banbou (20/1)
